name: Thailand — Phuket & Islands
about: Cool-dry season Nov–Feb is the sweet spot; monsoon Jun–Oct brings rough seas and closed island services.
overview: Limestone karsts, turquoise water, and a beach-resort scene ranging from backpacker bungalows to some of Asia's most iconic luxury hotels.
costOverview: Street food and local transport cost almost nothing — an island-hopping day tour to Phi Phi or Phang Nga is the one real splurge most visitors build a day around.
monthlyWeather: dry, sunny, and one of the most pleasant months of the year
